sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
HEXIS Graphics manufactures and distributes adhesive films for digital printing, signage, vehicle marking, and textile applications.

Industry: Manufacturing · Size: not published · Products: Adhesive Films, Solar Films, PPF (Paint Protection Film), Covering Films, Decorative Films, Signage Films

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: HEXIS Graphics scores 36 of 100 (tier disqualified) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (16/30) and event engagement (15/15). Nothing was found for application fit and company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on graffiti resistance, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (58% similar on films, protection, graphics, vehicle); Mactac (42% similar on films, signage, protection, film); ORAFOL Europe (36% similar on films, graphics, digital, printing). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.

sections.heading: Who to talk to
sections.body: No decision-maker resolved from public sources. Target titles for this ICP: VP Product, VP Product Development, VP Innovation, VP Research and Development, Director of R&D.

sections.heading: Gaps and risks
sections.body:
• Application fit: 4 more application area(s) would reach the ceiling.
• Company size: Any published revenue or headcount would unlock up to 15 points.
• Flags on the record: size unknown
